The six records preserve three source-computed Fe configurations for each spin state. They are deliberately model variants rather than six material identities. The authors choose model 1 for subsequent thermodynamics and find high-spin Fe stable through lower-mantle pressures; low-spin records are metastable computational comparisons.

## Automatic selections

- **Equilibrium:** [mg09375fe00625sio3\_bridgmanite\_metsue\_2012\_hs\_model1\_bm3](#record-mg09375fe00625sio3_bridgmanite_metsue_2012_hs_model1_bm3)
- **Hugoniot:** None
